question: I need you to look into the actor collaborations and tell me how many actors have made more films with Yash Chopra than with any other director. This will help us understand his influence on the industry better.
sql:
WITH actor_director_films AS (
    SELECT TRIM(c.PID) AS actor_pid, 
           TRIM(d.PID) AS director_pid, 
           TRIM(p.Name) AS actor_name,
           COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(c.MID)) AS film_count
    FROM M_Cast c
    JOIN M_Director d ON TRIM(c.MID) = TRIM(d.MID)
    JOIN Person p ON TRIM(c.PID) = p.PID
    GROUP BY TRIM(c.PID), TRIM(d.PID), TRIM(p.Name)
),
yc_counts AS (
    SELECT actor_pid, actor_name, film_count
    FROM actor_director_films
    WHERE director_pid = 'nm0007181'
),
max_other_counts AS (
    SELECT actor_pid, actor_name, 
           MAX(film_count) AS max_films_with_other_director
    FROM actor_director_films
    WHERE director_pid != 'nm0007181'
    GROUP BY actor_pid, actor_name
),
qualified_with_others AS (
    SELECT yc.actor_pid, yc.actor_name, yc.film_count AS films_with_yc, moc.max_films_with_other_director
    FROM yc_counts yc
    JOIN max_other_counts moc ON yc.actor_pid = moc.actor_pid AND yc.actor_name = moc.actor_name
    WHERE yc.film_count > moc.max_films_with_other_director
),
qualified_without_others AS (
    SELECT yc.actor_pid, yc.actor_name, yc.film_count AS films_with_yc, 0 AS max_films_with_other_director
    FROM yc_counts yc
    LEFT JOIN actor_director_films adf ON yc.actor_pid = adf.actor_pid AND yc.actor_name = adf.actor_name AND adf.director_pid != 'nm0007181'
    WHERE adf.actor_pid IS NULL
)
SELECT actor_pid, actor_name, films_with_yc, max_films_with_other_director
FROM qualified_with_others
UNION ALL
SELECT actor_pid, actor_name, films_with_yc, max_films_with_other_director
FROM qualified_without_others
